details:
All 13 acceptance criteria verified against the code:

1. Filter controls render: Template has dropdowns for assignee, priority, status and checkbox multi-select for tags. PASS
2. Search box renders: Text input with name="search" present in filter row. PASS
3. Assignee filter: Server-side filter on assignee field; default shows active chores for any assignee. PASS
4. Priority filter: Server-side filter on priority; default shows any priority. PASS
5. Status filter: Default shows active only; status=active/completed filters accordingly. PASS
6. Tags filter: Multi-select with OR logic via tags__id__in + distinct(). PASS
7. AND logic: Successive .filter() calls combine with AND. PASS
8. Search case-insensitive: Q(title__icontains=search) | Q(notes__icontains=search). PASS
9. Search + filters combine: Search applied after filters = AND logic. PASS
10. Immediate update: Auto-submit JS on select change, checkbox change, and debounced search input. Apply button exists but is NOT required (filters apply via query params alone). PASS
11. Clear all: 'Clear All' link when has_active_filters, links to base URL resetting all params. PASS
12. Empty state: 'No chores match your filters' shown when filters active and no results. PASS
13. No effect on other views: Calendar and Completed views ignore filter query params. PASS

Test coverage maps to every criterion. No gaps found between criteria, implementation, and tests.
